title: Toast's important option never escalates the live region to an alert
foundBy: an independent reviewer agent, one of three asked whether each component specification still describes the component that exists
details:
`components/ToastContainer.md:77` says `important: true` gives a toast no auto-dismiss and `role="alert"`. The same claim appears at `:63`.

`src/components/Toast.tsx:41` derives the role from the variant alone, testing for `warning` or `error`. The word `important` appears nowhere in that file, and `:46` and `:47` set `role` and `aria-live` from that test.

So `toast.info("Deploy failed", { important: true })` is announced politely rather than assertively. The auto-dismiss half of the promise does work, at `src/lib/toast.ts:39`.

The existing test pairs `important` with the `error` variant, which is already an alert, so it passes whether or not `important` is read.
